issue_context.title: Support boolean fields as dimensions
issue_context.body:
At the moment, the [`boolean`](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/boolean.html) field type is not allowed to be a dimensions, according to the [docs](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/tsds.html#time-series-dimension).

Boolean fields are valid types in OTel metric attributes. To work around this limitation, we're stringifying booleans to avoid data loss when booleans are used as attributes. 

To avoid breaking changes after GA, we should ideally have support for boolean attributes before we declare general availability for OTel metrics.

review_comments: I'd write 't' for true, 'f' for false. This is in line with https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/9c603a38f089d98bad47c365819d51d15f854e4c/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/XContentDataHelper.java#L354
